name: Red-White-Red Card -- Start-Up Founders / Self-Employed Key Workers

qualifying_event.description: A Red-White-Red Card sub-category for founders of innovative start-ups (points-assessed) and, separately, self-employed 'key workers' whose activity has a positive economic/labour-market effect. Assessed by the AMS labour-market service and the residence authority.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Business plan; proof of qualification/points-relevant criteria; financing evidence; (self-employed key workers) proof of expected positive economic effect.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum 50 of 85 possible points (qualifications up to 30, experience up to 10, languages up to 15, bonus criteria up to 30) plus an innovative business concept and minimum capital.

sources.title: workinaustria.com (AMS/ABA-run official relocation portal) -- Red-White-Red Card: Start-Up Founders points table (min. 50 of 85)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Austria).
